Frontend-proxy pod logs (important and full) primarily show Envoy initialization and a deprecation/resource-monitor warning; they did not contain explicit 'upstream connect error', 'connection refused', or DNS resolution failure lines in the returned log windows — so no direct textual log evidence of connection-refusal or DNS failure was captured in those log snippets.

While Envoy is the proximate producer of the UNAVAILABLE responses, the underlying cause may still be an upstream problem (frontend or ad) or transient network/health issues between proxy and upstream; logs did not show the classic connection error strings, so further investigation should target upstream health (frontend/ad), k8s Endpoints, Envoy upstream/cluster metrics (connection failures, hosts removed/unhealthy), and network connectivity to confirm the root cause beyond the proxy's egress failure.
